applyProposedRagPolicyForRequest: Apply the proposed RAG policy for request
atLeastOneKnowledgeBaseId: At least one knowledge base id is required.
emptyResidencyTags: Empty = no residency tags. Letters, digits, _.:- only.
enableAtLeastOneTier: Enable at least one retrieval tier.
expectedChunkIdsSeparated: Expected chunk ids (optional, comma or newline separated)
knowledgeBaseIdsSeparated: Knowledge base ids (comma or newline separated)
noChangeRequestDescription: Governance change requests appear here when an admin proposes a policy update.
pendingChangeRequestExists: The pending change request must be reviewed before another can be created.
policyPatchEmpty: The policy patch must include at least one field.
policyPatchJsonHelp: Enter the RAG policy fields to change as a JSON object.
policyPatchObjectRequired: The policy patch must be a JSON object.
ragEmbeddingModelHelp: One model for every collection. Dimensions must match, so changing this requires a full reindex.
ragEmbeddingEnableFirst: Enable an embedding-capable model in Admin → AI models first, then pick it here.
ragEmbeddingReindexWarning: After changing the embedding model, reindex each knowledge collection so existing vectors are rebuilt.
ragRetrievalHelp: How many matching chunks to keep, how similar they must be, and whether to mix keyword search with vectors.
ragRetrievalInvalid: Enter a results count from 1–20 and similarity / hybrid weights between 0 and 1.
ragTopKHelp: How many chunks to send to the model (1–20).
ragSimilarityHelp: Minimum cosine similarity for a vector hit. Higher is stricter (0–1).
ragHybridSearchHelp: Combine keyword (lexical) matches with vector similarity. Turn off to use vectors only.
ragBm25WeightHelp: Share of hybrid ranking given to keyword matches. The rest is vector similarity.
ragTiersHelp: Which collections chat is allowed to search. Workspace is the usual default.
ragTierOrgHelp: Organization-wide collections created by an admin.
ragSetupDescription: Pick the vector backend, one embedding model, retrieval knobs, and which collection scopes chat may search.
ragVectorBackendHelp: pgvector is bundled with Romeo Postgres. Qdrant is optional and requires deployment env (QDRANT_URL).
ragBackendPgvectorHelp: Store and search vectors in Postgres. Best for single-node and Compose installs.
ragBackendQdrantHelp: Use Qdrant for external indexing when configured. Postgres remains authoritative for reindex/DR.
ragValidateDescription: Check deployment posture against your setup, then optionally run a live tiered retrieval test.
ragTestRetrievalHelp: Runs knowledge.queryTiered against knowledge bases you can use. Requires indexed embeddings for vector hits.
ragAgenticHelp: When enabled, retrieval can rewrite and split the question and search again if the first hits are weak. Off by default so ordinary chats stay one-shot.
ragAgenticUserModeHelp: Optional lets each member toggle it in the composer. Required runs it on every knowledge-backed message.
ragAdvancedHelp: Vector backend and data-residency tags. Change these when you are changing where embeddings live, not for everyday retrieval.
